evidence.appropriate: the name's own p becomes a puppet on a stick, mouth open mid-word: the librarian's puppet reading aloud, no story needed
evidence.distinctive: no competitor builds its character from its initial; probe: 5 of 20 for "letter p face logo" (faces set into a P), so capped at 3
evidence.simple: one letter, one wedge and one eye; drawable from memory; 30 anchors
evidence.legible: the p reads at every size; at 16 px the mouth notch makes the bowl read close to an F or a P, still a letter of the name; thinnest feature 4.97 px
evidence.adaptable: one colour, reversed clean; small and favicon tiers deepen the mouth and enlarge the eye; compact built
evidence.timeless: a mono-initial from the wordmark's own DNA is a use-carefully trend, justified by the mascot strategy; no avoid item
evidence.universal: the open wedge carries a secondary Pac-Man reading, and in round 1 a beak; mirrored reads as a q, rotated as a creature with a dropped jaw
evidence.clear: description search found a P with a monkey face peeking from its bowl (Scale Branding stock) and Pringles' Mr. P, neither a talking p; image search skipped (no Chrome extension)
evidence.congruent: round, rounded humanist type from the territory, medium weight, open, a single dynamic note in the mouth; the stop-vowel-stop of Pip matches its snap
evidence.system: every lockup and tier derives from one glyph; the symbol shares the wordmark's family; rationale drafted in critique.md
